note: One sword move, one animation, two profiles. A profile is ONLY a set of slot bindings: which Niagara core system realises the slot, which material instance it wears, and the User.* values that drive it. Animation timing is never owned here - it belongs to the Sword line and reaches VFX as events (see docs/sword_vfx_event_contract.json).
profile_rule: Magic must call the SAME Sword Move as Normal. There is no MagicSwordAttackA1/A2. The only difference between the two swords is which profile is applied.

slot_map._note: Shared by both profiles. A slot is a moment in the sword presentation; the map says which core systems are composited to realise it. Changing this map changes BOTH swords, which is the point of keeping it out of the profiles.

slot_notes.IdleVFX: section 14 / 6. Normal is deliberately near-zero here: a cold blade does not smoke. Magic is a few motes and a thin wisp, never a continuous smoke machine.
slot_notes.EquipGlint: section 7. Blade is only 12-20 cm out; ONE narrow highlight scans the exposed steel, 80-160 ms. Normal: silver-white. Magic: purple, and still reads as LIGHT running along the steel - never the whole sword becoming a purple tube.
slot_notes.InspectGlint: section 8. The SAME glint core as EquipGlint, retuned: slower, and travelling base -> tip instead of a partial scan. This is why the glint is a parameterised component rather than two effects.
slot_notes.BladeTrail: section 9. Thickness is the whole identity: extremely thin. A thick trail would read as a separate effect rather than as the edge of this blade.
slot_notes.A1Slice: section 9 / 17. Peak only. Normal is a pressure cut in AIR, ~1.5-2.5 m, NOT a projectile. Magic keeps the identical geometry and adds a thread of black vapour along the original path.
slot_notes.A2Wave: section 10 / 18. A thin curved PRESSURE SHEET, 6-10 m, NOT a thick blue crescent. Bright edge, faint interior, distortion in the tail only.
slot_notes.A3Scar: section 11 / 19. WORLD-space, three separate cuts, never screen space, never HUD. Magic is the hero of this batch and the one place that can FAIL: three scars must still read as three.
slot_notes.A4Arc: section 12 / 21. 240-300 degrees, NOT a 360 ring. The arc forms live with the blade so START, SWEEP and END are all visible.
slot_notes.IaidoDraw: section 22. The new Iaido motion. Normal: cold draw glint. Magic: purple draw glint.
slot_notes.IaidoScar: section 22 / 19. The cut of the new Iaido line, i.e. the void scar rather than the A3 triple.
slot_notes.SheatheVFX: section 22. As the blade approaches the saya the mist steadily reduces; once the blade is truly IN, the mist is pulled back in. On the final click one point appears at the saya mouth for 20-50 ms, then ALL vfx return to zero. This beat must be very clean and is the last thing the player sees.
slot_notes.HitBody: contact family. Colour is the blade's own, so a Normal hit never flashes purple.
slot_notes.HitStone: contact family. Substrate test: a sword that cuts space should still sound and look different on stone.
slot_notes.HitMetal: contact family. Metal is the one that must not be handed to a bright additive - brief section 32 is about overdraw and metal hits are the usual offender.
slot_notes.HitWood: contact family. The softest read of the four; the only one where a small amount of material breakup is allowed.

VP_Sword_Normal.implies: few particles, more Ribbon / Mesh / Material / world-space geometry / distortion. Section 6 forbids solving this with particle count.

IdleVFX.why: deliberately silent: a cold blade does not idle. Zero, not small.

EquipGlint.why: 12-20 cm of exposed blade, 140 ms scan, silver-white.

InspectGlint.why: same core, slower, full base->tip travel.

BladeTrail.why: thin is the identity. Width above 0.06 stops reading as an edge.

A1Slice.why: 50-100 ms at the peak only. Air pressure, not a projectile. NOTE: the slice is a 6 cm scar-strip MESH drawn on start->end by the scar mask's U wipe, so it wears the flat scar material rather than the ribbon's trail material - an earlier revision of this spec said MI_SW_Trail_Normal and the slot-binding check below caught it.

A2Wave.why: 8.0 m at 34 m/s = 0.235 s, inside the 0.18-0.35 s band. Distortion is tail-only.

A3Scar.why: space remembers three cuts. Mist is 0.05 - present only so the core system stays identical.

A4Arc.why: 300 degrees, not 360. ArcStart/ArcEnd exist so the ring can never silently close.

IaidoDraw.why: the 100 ms draw (tuning 4.68 -> 4.78) is short and axial.

IaidoScar.why: void_life is 1.0 s in the tuning; the scar is the readable part of it.

SheatheVFX.why: Normal has nothing to suck back in. Kept as a slot so the click cue has one home.

keywords: the sword cuts space and darkness leaks through the cut
VP_Sword_Magic.implies: section 13: this is NOT a purple reskin of Normal. Every slot must read as the same swordsmanship with something leaking through it. No neon purple, ever.

IdleVFX.why: a few motes and a thin wisp - section 14 explicitly forbids a continuous smoke machine.

EquipGlint.why: same scan as Normal, purple. Section 15: still light running along the steel.

InspectGlint.why: motion unchanged from Normal; only the values differ.

BladeTrail.why: marginally thicker than Normal so the violet body reads, still an edge.

A1Slice.why: section 17: identical geometry, purple-white core, black vapour along the ORIGINAL path only. 0.15-0.30 s. Wears the scar material for the same reason as Normal.

A2Wave.why: same shape and gameplay. Black mist is a short WAKE, not a fireball and not lightning.

A3Scar.why: HERO BEAT, section 19. Core purple-white, inner deep purple, an extremely narrow black void outside it. Mist leaks gently and expands slowly along the scar normal - never a burst. Section 20: if the hero frame shows one mass of purple-black smoke it is a FAIL, so MistAmount is capped here on purpose.

A4Arc.why: section 21: same geometry, leading edge purple-white, and the black wake behind must NOT close into a ring. ArcStart/ArcEnd enforce the gap.

IaidoDraw.why: purple draw glint on the identical new Iaido motion.

IaidoScar.why: purple void scar cut, same construction as A3.

SheatheVFX.why: section 22. This is the ONLY slot that starts at full mist, because it is the one that has to visibly empty: mist reduces as the blade nears the saya, is suctioned in once the blade is truly inside, then one purple point on the click for 20-50 ms and everything returns to zero. The final beat must be clean.
